name: Zigbee coordinator (kitsune)
description: A kitsune fox that forms a Zigbee network as coordinator on an 802.15.4 channel with a spoofed EUI-64. Boards with an 802.15.4 radio only. Configuration is compiled into the firmware from a conference header; this page prepares, checks and exports that header (docs/kitsune-integration-plan.md). kitsune belongs to its authors: https://github.com/rfhs/kitsune
